job.name: ig54_host

job.meaning: крутой уверенный мужчина ~45 в дорогой тёмной студии подкаста: короткая стрижка, аккуратная борода с проседью, чёрная рубашка, часы, микрофон
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame from a premium podcast. A confident, successful Russian man about 45 with a short sharp haircut, a well-groomed dark beard with some grey, strong jaw, calm piercing eyes, wearing a fitted black shirt with the top button open and a steel luxury watch, sitting in a dark leather armchair, leaning slightly forward, one hand gesturing calmly. A black studio microphone on a boom arm in front of him, below his face, not covering the mouth. He looks straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, serious and charismatic, NO smile. Medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge. Background: dark expensive studio with acoustic wood panels, warm amber practical lights and soft bokeh. Real camera frame, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
